serverInfo.name: apis.io
serverInfo.title: APIs.io API catalog MCP server
serverInfo.description: Discover, rate and compare APIs and providers in the APIs.io catalog; manage a listing you own.

transport.note: This server READS AND WRITES: 124 of 141 tools read, 17 write, 2 of those destructive. Streamable HTTP JSON-RPC; call initialize, then tools/list, then tools/call. Every tool declares its own readOnlyHint, and every write declares destructiveHint. The write tools concern a listing you own or a request you are filing, and each returns 202 to be worked by a person — none publishes anything or moves a score on its own; save_search/create_list/add_to_list write only to your own workspace. Anonymous callers get the free catalog surface with no key: search, providers, apis, tags, taxonomy, artifacts, the playground, and everything about ONE provider. Synthesis across the catalog (ratings, cohorts, capabilities, operations, insights, stack design, resolve/enrich) needs the Understanding tier; agent-readiness across the catalog, vendor comparison, gap analysis and the own-your-listing surface need Influence (https://apis.io/developer/plans/).

authorization.note: Anonymous access is supported for the free tier; OAuth 2.1 authorization-code + PKCE (S256) with dynamic client registration raises the tier. An x-api-key header is accepted as an alternative and meters on the same per-user key.
